clauses.why: Verse 13 says he gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek, not Ammon and Amalek themselves; verse 12 only says the LORD strengthened him, so the citation should be 3:13.
clauses.english: gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek and defeated Israel
clauses.ukr: зібрав до себе синів Аммонових та Амаликових і підбив Ізраїля
clauses.deu: sammelte die Kinder Ammon und die Amalekiter zu sich und schlug Israel
clauses.spa: juntó consigo a los hijos de Ammón y de Amalec e hirió a Israel

clauses.why: Israel served him, so the actor is Israel's service to Eglon; the passive form is supported, but the clause is better stated as received service.
clauses.english: was served by Israel for eighteen years
clauses.ukr: йому служили сини Ізраїлеві вісімнадцять літ
clauses.deu: ihm dienten die Kinder Israel achtzehn Jahre
clauses.spa: le sirvieron los hijos de Israel diez y ocho años
